title: Ex-DPWH engineer denies falsifying inspection certificate, admits relying on contractor reports for Mindoro road dike

blocks.text: A former Department of Public Works and Highways engineer on Thursday denied falsifying an inspection certificate for a Naujan, Oriental Mindoro road dike project, but admitted he often relied on contractor reports because he could not be present at critical stages of construction.
